facts.content: Episodic headaches at work with mild nausea are likely tension-type or stress-related with a need to screen for visual strain.
facts.source_text: Episodic headaches at work with mild nausea—likely tension-type or stress-related; screen for visual strain

facts.content: Palpitations with intermittent SOB at rest requires ruling out thyroid dysfunction, arrhythmia, anxiety/stress-related etiology.
facts.source_text: Palpitations with intermittent SOB at rest—rule out thyroid dysfunction, arrhythmia, anxiety/stress-related etiology

facts.content: Bilateral hand paresthesias are possibly due to hyperventilation or anxiety; consider neuropathy or B12 deficiency.
facts.source_text: Bilateral hand paresthesias—possible hyperventilation/anxiety; consider neuropathy, B12 deficiency; distribution non-dermatomal

facts.content: Unintentional weight loss (~5 lb) and decreased appetite may suggest thyrotoxicosis or stress/anxiety; monitor trends.
facts.source_text: Unintentional wt loss (~5 lb) and ↓ appetite—consider thyrotoxicosis, stress/anxiety; monitor trend

facts.content: Decreased libido is likely multifactorial, including stress and thyroid status.
facts.source_text: ↓ libido—likely multifactorial (stress, thyroid status)

facts.content: Plan for an in-person visit to include full exam with vitals, BMI, cardio-respiratory exam, neurological screen, and thyroid palpation.
facts.source_text: In-person visit: full exam incl. vitals, BMI, cardio-resp exam, neuro screen, thyroid palpation

facts.content: Plan for labs: TSH, free T4/T3, CBC, CMP, fasting glucose/HbA1c, B12/folate, ferritin, Mg, consider lipid panel, ESR/CRP.
facts.source_text: Labs: TSH, free T4/T3; CBC; CMP; fasting glucose/HbA1c; B12/folate; ferritin; Mg; consider lipid panel, ESR/CRP

facts.content: Perform a 12-lead ECG; consider an ambulatory Holter if palpitations frequent or persistent or ECG abnormal.
facts.source_text: Cardiac: 12-lead ECG; consider ambulatory Holter if palpitations frequent/persistent or ECG abnl

facts.content: For headaches and vision ergonomics: assess visual acuity, consider screen breaks, hydration, and ergonomics, OTC simple analgesia PRN if no contraindications.
facts.source_text: Headache/vision/ergonomics: assess visual acuity; consider screen breaks, hydration, ergonomics; OTC simple analgesia PRN if no contraindications

facts.content: For SOB/palpitations episodes: screen for anxiety/panic, provide education on breathing techniques once serious causes are excluded.
facts.source_text: SOB/palpitations episodes: screen for anxiety/panic; breathing techniques education once serious causes excluded

facts.content: For weight, appetite, and libido concerns: monitor weight, review sleep and stress management, consider PHQ-9/GAD-7.
facts.source_text: Weight/appetite/libido: monitor weight; review sleep, stress management; consider PHQ-9/GAD-7

facts.content: Review thyroid medication by verifying Thyroxine dose, adherence, and timing; adjust according to lab results.
facts.source_text: Thyroid med review: verify thyroxine dose, adherence, timing; adjust per labs

facts.content: Safety return strategy includes recognition of red flags such as chest pain, syncope, resting SOB, neuro deficits, severe headaches, or rapid weight loss to seek urgent care.
facts.source_text: Safety/return: red flags—chest pain, syncope, persistent/resting SOB, neuro deficits, severe/worst headache, rapid wt loss—seek urgent care

facts.content: Book clinic appointment via app; review results and symptoms in 1-2 weeks or sooner if symptoms worsen.
facts.source_text: Follow-up: book clinic appointment via app; review results and symptoms in 1–2 weeks or sooner if worsening
